briefings.headline: Hunt Painter’s fastball; stay disciplined on the soft stuff
briefings.message: Andrew Painter is the assumed starter, but the projection is low confidence. Left-handed hitters, look for fastballs; right-handed hitters, be ready for breaking balls but prioritize damage on hittable fastballs. Don’t chase the slider, splitter, or changeup out of the zone. Jhoan Duran, Orion Kerkering, and Tim Mayza are the rested bullpen arms to watch if Philadelphia turns to its relief corps.
reminders: Make Painter bring offspeed into the zone.
Attack fastballs you can drive; avoid expanding on breaking balls.
Brewer Hicklen’s matchup signal is based on a small sample.

briefings.headline: Mahle sets the tone: change speeds and keep the ball out of the middle
briefings.message: Tyler Mahle starts, with a 90-pitch limit and a target of 5.0 innings. Keep fastballs out of the middle to Kyle Schwarber and Bryce Harper; use the splitter and breaking ball to change speeds and get chase below the zone. Stay down against Trea Turner, and challenge Justin Crawford in the zone while limiting free passes. Build relief innings with rested arms first; Dylan Lee and Reynaldo López are limited, and Raisel Iglesias is unavailable.
reminders: Use rested relief first; Bailey Falter is the length option if Mahle exits early.
Reserve limited arms for need; Iglesias is unavailable.
Keep Crawford off base and be alert to his speed.

briefings.headline: Approved plan: fastball-hunt lineup, Mahle start, rested relief first
briefings.message: Andrew Painter is a low-confidence assumption; keep the lineup focused on hittable fastballs and disciplined against breaking balls and offspeed. Brewer Hicklen stays a selective bench option because his apparent edge is based on a small sample. Tyler Mahle starts, with a 90-pitch limit and a 5.0-inning target; rested relief leads the plan. Dylan Lee, Didier Fuentes, Victor Mederos, and Reynaldo López are limited, while Raisel Iglesias is unavailable. Acuña, Baldwin, and Olson remain in despite rest suggestions; Riley gets the rest day.
reminders: Use Hicklen selectively; do not treat his small-sample edge as a starting case.
Prefer rested bullpen options; preserve limited arms unless needed.
Keep the approved lineup and pitching roles aligned with the plan.
